notes: Each valid example is a standalone structural example, not one sequential transcript.
Schema validation does not establish authorization, lease freshness, deduplication, role ownership, correct clues, or physical readiness. Those require domain tests.
Firmware and physical layouts use portrait dimensions from audited hardware profiles.

invalid_examples.name: pressed_without_press_id
invalid_examples.reason: A true press requires a positive press ID.

invalid_examples.name: release_with_press_id
invalid_examples.reason: Released input has null press ID.

invalid_examples.name: box_command_missing_arm
invalid_examples.reason: Actuation requires an explicit arm generation.

invalid_examples.name: box_confirmed_without_evidence
invalid_examples.reason: A historical position_confirmed outcome requires recorded command_confirmation; current position basis alone is not that evidence.

invalid_examples.name: seal_lacks_clue
invalid_examples.reason: Seal phase requires its role-filtered clue projection.

invalid_examples.name: readiness_arm_without_session
invalid_examples.reason: An active arm must name its session.

invalid_examples.name: confirmation_on_unconfirmed_outcome
invalid_examples.reason: command_confirmation must be null unless the named command outcome is position_confirmed.

invalid_examples.name: simulation_cannot_claim_physical_confirmation
invalid_examples.reason: A server-owned simulated projection cannot report physical position_confirmed evidence.
